analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for the third consecutive day. RSI is hovering around the 50 level with no clear direction, and while the MACD histogram is improving, it remains in weak convergence. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.25x the 5-day average, reducing confidence in a trend reversal.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($385.63) vs SMA5 ($380.40) / SMA20 ($383.18) / SMA50 ($395.41) — Trading above SMA5/20, below SMA50, indicating short-term upward attempt with potential for mid-term trend reversal to down.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($382.95) / SMA200 ($364.71) — Mid-to-long-term trend remains strong.
· 52-week Position (48.7%) + Current price level near historical median.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (51.9 → 50.1) — Continued sideways movement in the neutral zone, indicating lack of directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (2.1953 → 0.2904) — Improving but still in weak convergence, signaling a weak trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $383.18) — Sideways movement near the middle band, with a band width of 11.11%, indicating a period of reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($370.65) — Confirmed support based on Pivot S1 ($358.87) and 200-day Moving Average ($364.71).
· Swing Resistance ($386.48) — Resistance zone around Pivot R1 ($409.96) and Bollinger Upper Band ($404.46).
· 5-day / 20-day High-Low Pattern — No clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern identified; classified as a sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.25x vs 5-day average) — Subdued volume reduces the reliability of price movements.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Uncertain trend reversal signals due to neutral RSI, weak MACD convergence, and low volume; maintaining a 'wait and see' approach.
